title: KWA Water Supply Interruption on Sunday (Ward 14)
body: Kerala Water Authority announced maintenance work on the main pumping station at Aruvikkara. Water supply will be suspended in Poojappura, Jagathy, and Karamana from 8 AM to 6 PM this Sunday.

title: Free Rabies Vaccination & Pet Microchipping Camp
body: Thiruvananthapuram Municipal Corporation Animal Husbandry Dept is conducting a free anti-rabies vaccination camp for pet and community dogs at Poojappura Ground this Saturday starting 9:00 AM.

title: KSEB Scheduled Power Feeder Upgrades at Pappanamcode
body: Scheduled power outage from 10 AM to 3 PM on Wednesday for installation of new high-capacity distribution transformers near SCT College and Industrial Estate.
